heroHeading: When the problem is bigger than a meeting.
heroIntro: Some problems don't need another presentation. They need someone to understand what is really happening, work through the trade-offs with leadership, design a response and help turn it into execution.
positioningHeading: I am usually most useful when the answer isn't obvious yet.

situations.title: The organisation has grown faster than its operating model.
situations.description: Processes, teams and systems that worked at one stage no longer work at the next.

situations.title: The CEO knows something needs to change, but the real problem is still unclear.
situations.description: Several symptoms are appearing across functions and leadership needs someone to diagnose the underlying constraint.

situations.title: Strategy exists, but execution keeps breaking between functions.
situations.description: Everyone has a plan. Nobody owns the hand-offs.

situations.title: A founder needs to rethink the product, GTM or business model.
situations.description: The company may be pushing harder when the better answer is changing direction.

situations.title: AI is being discussed, but nobody has defined what actually needs to change.
situations.description: Technology selection is happening before operating-model design.

situations.title: An emerging industry needs more than company-building.
situations.description: Regulation, government, infrastructure, partners and ecosystem development become part of the strategy.

engagementTypes.title: Strategic Diagnostic
engagementTypes.description: For situations where leadership knows something is wrong but has not yet isolated the real constraint.
engagementTypes.outcome: A sharper problem definition, current-state view, priorities and recommended response.

engagementTypes.title: Transformation Engagement
engagementTypes.description: For organisations that need to move from diagnosis into operating-model, process, technology and execution change.
engagementTypes.outcome: A structured transformation programme with governance and execution mechanisms.

engagementTypes.title: CEO / Founder Advisory
engagementTypes.description: For leaders who need an ongoing strategic thought partner across priorities, operating questions and difficult decisions.

engagementTypes.title: Investor / Portfolio Support
engagementTypes.description: For investors who need help diagnosing operating, scaling or transformation challenges inside a portfolio company.

engagementTypes.title: 0→1 & Scale-up Support
engagementTypes.description: For businesses refining a product, business model, GTM or organisational capability while moving toward the next stage.

engagementTypes.title: Policy & Ecosystem Projects
engagementTypes.description: For government, institutions or emerging sectors where company-building intersects with policy, research, regulation or ecosystem infrastructure.

openToLine: I am also open to Board / leadership opportunities and speaking engagements.
